# `question`

> Profile: core · Permission key: `[permission] question`

Ask the user one or more clarifying questions with optional multiple-choice options. Prefer this over guessing when requirements, approach, or risk are ambiguous. Each question may set multi_select. The UI always offers an Other free-text path. Use short labels and helpful descriptions; put the recommended option first.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `choices` | array of string | no | Legacy string choices for the single-question form |
| `important` | boolean | no | Legacy: if true, prompt even in auto mode |
| `multi_select` | boolean | no | Legacy multi_select for the single-question form |
| `question` | string | no | Legacy single-question form |
| `questions` | array of object | no | One or more questions (preferred). Max 4 recommended. |
